questions.statement:
A taxi in New York City charges $2.50 initial fare plus $0.50 per quarter mile. If Maya pays $7.50 for a ride, how many miles did she travel?

A) 5 miles
B) 8 miles
C) 10 miles
D) 12 miles
**[ ]** → **C**

---

Which of the following is equivalent to 2(4x − 3) + 5x?

A) 13x − 3
B) 13x − 6
C) 8x − 3
D) 8x − 6
**[ ]** → **B**

---

A bus ticket from Los Angeles to San Francisco costs $45. A student group has $540 to spend on bus tickets. If they buy as many tickets as possible, how much money will they have left?

A) $0
B) $45
C) $90
D) $135
**[ ]** → **B**

---

If 2x − 5 > 3, what is the solution set?

A) x > 4
B) x > 1
C) x < 4
D) x < 1
**[ ]** → **A**

---

A phone plan in Texas charges $20 per month plus $0.08 per text message. If a customer's bill was $36, how many text messages did they send?

A) 100
B) 150
C) 200
D) 250
**[ ]** → **C**

---

What is the slope of the line passing through points (2, 5) and (6, 13)?

A) 1
B) 2
C) 3
D) 4
**[ ]** → **B**

---

A plumber in Chicago charges a $75 service call plus $45 per hour. If a job costs $210, how many hours did the plumber work?

A) 2 hours
B) 3 hours
C) 4 hours
D) 5 hours
**[ ]** → **B**

---

A school's student council in Florida has $800 to spend on yearbook ads. Full-page ads cost $120 and half-page ads cost $75. If they buy 3 full-page ads, what is the maximum number of half-page ads they can also buy?

A) 4
B) 5
C) 6
D) 7
**[ ]** → **B**

---

Which inequality represents "three times a number is at least 12"?

A) 3x ≤ 12
B) 3x ≥ 12
C) 3x < 12
D) 3x > 12
**[ ]** → **B**

---

A line has equation 2x + 3y = 12. What is the y-intercept?

A) 2
B) 3
C) 4
D) 6
**[ ]** → **C**

---

A fitness gym in Seattle charges $45 per month. A new member pays $120 for the first three months including a $15 registration fee. How much does the monthly membership cost after the promotional period?

A) $35
B) $40
C) $45
D) $50
**[ ]** → **C**

---

If f(x) = 4x − 7, what value of x makes f(x) = 21?

A) 3.5
B) 5.5
C) 7
D) 14
**[ ]** → **C**

---

A rectangle's length is 3 more than twice its width. If the perimeter is 54 cm, what is the width?

A) 6 cm
B) 8 cm
C) 12 cm
D) 15 cm
**[ ]** → **B**

---

The cost of producing x custom t-shirts in Austin is given by C(x) = 250 + 8x. If each shirt sells for $22, how many shirts must be sold to break even?

A) 15
B) 18
C) 20
D) 25
**[ ]** → **D**

---

Solve the inequality: −4x + 6 ≤ 2x − 18

A) x ≥ 4
B) x ≤ 4
C) x ≥ −4
D) x ≤ −4
**[ ]** → **A**

---

A shipping company in Miami charges $8 per pound plus a flat fee of $12. For an order weighing 25 pounds, what is the total cost?

A) $200
B) $212
C) $224
D) $236
**[ ]** → **B**

---

Two trains leave stations 400 miles apart and travel toward each other. One travels at 60 mph and the other at 80 mph. In how many hours will they meet?

A) 2 hours
B) 2.5 hours
C) 2.86 hours
D) 3 hours
**[ ]** → **C**

A catering company in Boston charges $15 per person for a lunch event plus a $200 setup fee. If the total cost for an event was $1,000, how many attendees were there?

A) 40
B) 50
C) 53
D) 60
**[ ]** → **C**

A recipe in New York requires 3 cups of flour to make 24 cookies. How many cups of flour are needed to make 72 cookies?

A) 6 cups
B) 9 cups
C) 12 cups
D) 15 cups

A car travels 180 miles on 6 gallons of gas. At this rate, how many gallons are needed for 300 miles?

B) 10 gallons
C) 12 gallons
D) 15 gallons

B) $9.00
C) $9.50
D) $10.00

A baseball team in Texas won 28 games out of 40 played. What is the team's winning percentage?

A) 60%
B) 65%

D) 75%

If 3 workers can paint a fence in 8 hours, how long would it take 6 workers to paint the same fence at the same rate?

A) 2 hours
B) 3 hours

A) $16,000
B) $17,000
C) $18,000
D) $20,000

A mixture of 60% sand and 40% clay is used to make bricks. How much clay should be mixed with 45 pounds of sand?

A) 20 pounds
B) 25 pounds
C) 30 pounds
D) 35 pounds

A train leaves Chicago at 8 AM traveling at 60 mph. Another train leaves at 10 AM traveling at 80 mph in the same direction. At what time will the second train catch up?

A) 2 PM
B) 3 PM
C) 4 PM
D) 5 PM

A jacket originally priced at $120 is discounted by 15%, then taxed at 8%. What is the final price?

A) $99.36
B) $102.96
C) $105.60

Three numbers are in the ratio 3:5:7 and their sum is 105. What is the largest number?

D) 56

A boat travels downstream 36 miles in 3 hours. The return trip takes 4 hours. What is the speed of the current?

A) 1.5 mph
B) 2 mph

A) 82

B) 36%

A man is 4 times as old as his son. In 20 years, he will be twice as old. How old is the son now?

A) 5 years
B) 10 years
C) 15 years

A right triangle has legs of length 6 and 8. What is the length of the hypotenuse?

What is the distance between points (−3, 4) and (5, −2)?

Line segment AB has endpoints A(2, 5) and B(10, 13). What is the slope of the line perpendicular to AB?

A triangle has vertices at (0,0), (5,0), and (3,4). What is its area?

A triangle has sides 9, 12, and 15. What is the area?

A) 1/4

A) 150

A) 2.1
B) 3.0
C) 3.5
D) 7.0

In a survey at a high school in New Jersey, 180 out of 400 students said they exercise daily. With a margin of error of 4%, what is the range of students who exercise daily?

A) 164-196

C) 176-196
